'''Dried kelp strips''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] item served in the chow hall of [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit/Legends|Republic Mobile Surgical Unit]] [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7|7]], a field hospital located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="MedStar I" /> In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'' to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] once ate a breakfast of [[grainmush]] cakes, [[poptree syrup]], and dried kelp strips.<ref name="MedStar I" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dried kelp strips first appeared in ''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]'', a [[2004]] [[Clone Wars multimedia project|''Clone Wars'']] novel written by [[Steve Perry]] and [[Michael Reaves]] as the first part of the ''[[MedStar Duology]]''.<ref name="MedStar I" />
